subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message activity through the existing system-event/inbound-runner primitives, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook, adapter slot, or runtime dispatch API?
rationale: Source inspection proves a public gap, but choosing the permanent Plugin SDK contract affects third-party compatibility and overlaps with open reaction-hook and inbound_activity work.

options.title: Document Current Primitives First
options.body: Treat reactions, edits, and read receipts as plugin-generated system events plus optional heartbeat wake when that covers the use case, and add docs/tests before new SDK surface.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Event Contract
options.body: Define a typed observation or dispatch contract for non-message channel events, then align it with the related inbound_activity and reaction-hook trackers before merging implementations.

options.title: Defer Pending Plugin Proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why system events and runChannelInboundEvent cannot express the required semantics before accepting API growth.

recommendation.title: Document Current Primitives First
recommendation.body: Treat reactions, edits, and read receipts as plugin-generated system events plus optional heartbeat wake when that covers the use case, and add docs/tests before new SDK surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the shared chat plugin builder and plugin SDK boundary that this API decision would change.
